question: This is a student management system. The system manages student information (student ID, name, gender, age, etc.), class information (class name, major, classroom, etc.), sports team information (team name, activity time, coach, etc.), and dormitory information (dormitory number, building number, administrator, number of residents, etc.). The system also maintains the relationships between students and classes, students and sports teams, and students and dormitories.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0499

-- Table: students
CREATE TABLE `students` (
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `gender` char(6) NOT NULL,
  `age` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

-- Table: classes
CREATE TABLE `classes` (
  `class_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `major` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `classroom` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`class_name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

-- Table: sports_teams
CREATE TABLE `sports_teams` (
  `team_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `activity_time` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `coach` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`team_name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

-- Table: dormitories
CREATE TABLE `dormitories` (
  `dormitory_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `building_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `administrator` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `number_of_residents` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`dormitory_number`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

-- Table: student_classes
CREATE TABLE `student_classes` (
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `class_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`,`class_name`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `students` (`student_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`class_name`) REFERENCES `classes` (`class_name`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

-- Table: student_sports_teams
CREATE TABLE `student_sports_teams` (
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `team_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`,`team_name`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `students` (`student_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`team_name`) REFERENCES `sports_teams` (`team_name`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

-- Table: student_dormitories
CREATE TABLE `student_dormitories` (
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `dormitory_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`,`dormitory_number`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `students` (`student_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`dormitory_number`) REFERENCES `dormitories` (`dormitory_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
